host_validation.source: Coordinator read the actual completed host check-stage run and node validation=passed; prior local evidence retained with its original scope.

result.summary: Historical entrypoint: 6 fixtures; 110 compiler passes plus 2 skips; 57 topology; 1 main-contract; 6 runtime passes. Later candidate checks are listed in HANDOFF.md.

contract.completion: Check success is necessary but not sufficient. Verify the stated outcome and required external input; no fabricated result or silent skip.
contract.execution: Explicitly select these registered check IDs; an omitted list inherits all project checks and would run unrelated/full checks prematurely.
write_scope: Current repository implementation, contracts and focused tests required by this milestone; existing user changes are preserved.

outcome: Measure compile/runtime cost, peak memory and capture/allocation work versus a correct full-snapshot baseline. Vary history capacity, task count and references. Keep an optimization only with measured benefit and unchanged semantics; no invented percentage target.

result.baseline_variant: Temporary capture-all-in-scope-rings patch built and measured, then reverted; worktree verified byte-identical to the repair state before the final build. Saved baseline binary under build/task-resource-cost-20261011/bin/styio-fullsnap.
decisions: Retain selective capture for exact context/copy reduction when k<R; measured equality only applies to tested i64 cells. No universal wall/RSS or zero-regression claim.
Retain reviewer bulk numeric copies between separate existing arrays: high-capacity compiler/JIT benefit measured; owning-element operations retained.
Do not alias ctx as task-local ring storage; reject shortened live-window snapshots.

focused_tests.command: bash docs/plans/task-resource-delivery/checks.sh focused (entrypoint as executed at that node)
focused_tests.scope: Separate execution groups; no deduplicated task-wide total. The two platform-conditional cleanup cases were skipped, not passed. Later reviewer changes require affected verification in HANDOFF.md.

known_issues: Single-sample timings and RSS vary with host load; original numerical results are historical. Exact allocation/IR evidence and reviewer follow-up are separated in COST.md.
limitations: Single-sample compile wall times on a shared host
Runtime deltas only resolvable as aggregates at feasible scales
Only the macOS arm64 Debug build measured; O2 dead-store elimination inferred, not pass-log verified
No full regression, no Pafio/Vityo E2E, no Task/Tree delivery claim

measured_axes.capture_work: ctx malloc per spawn = captured_rings*(cap*8+8), verified against --llvm-ir (2056 vs 8224B probe; 16392 vs 65568B loop-k1); k=0 avoids the ctx allocation entirely; emitted copy instructions scale captured_rings*cap*sites (IR 574KB vs 1929KB on probe)
measured_axes.references: R=4 cap=2048 T=16, k in {0,1,2,4}: compile wall 0.21-31.10s selective vs 2.94-19.35s fullsnap; compiler peak RSS 64-537MB vs 447-518MB; JIT wall 0.09-66.29s vs 30.86-64.36s; identical outputs
measured_axes.runtime: Native exe 20-rep aggregates on loop-spawn cells: +0.4-2.1ms per 512-2048 spawns under fullsnap; exe peak-RSS deltas sub-MB to ~1MB (short-lived ctx)
measured_axes.scope: R=8 cap=2048 T=16 k=1: compile 6.88s vs 16.17s; compiler RSS 185MB vs 949MB; JIT 15.70s vs 69.00s

result.semantics_check: stdout sha256 identical between variants on all cells (native and JIT paths); focused check passed after revert+rebuild
result.summary: Measured correct i64 selective and full-snapshot implementations. Exact capture/allocation reductions support retaining selective snapshots; single-sample wall time and RSS do not prove universal improvements. Reviewer follow-up measures the repaired candidate and retains bulk numeric copies; see COST.md and HANDOFF.md.
